demoResults.label: Precomputed demonstration result
demoResults.description: Verified EPA SWMM 5.2.4 result of the approved Ward 176 candidate model for the historical Michaung 2023 rainfall (baseline, 1.00x). Loading it re-uses the archived SWMM report and binary output instead of re-running SWMM; all flood, bottleneck, exposure and recommendation products are processed from these real outputs by the normal pipeline.
demoResults.verification: The binary output is byte-identical to a live SWMM 5.2.4 run of the approved model started from the UI on 2026-09-14 (simulation 0ada7d8e-a519-4b42-a5c8-372497b816b6); the report differs only in the analysis start/end timestamps.
